Swati Mehendale Mumbai | +91- 90822 05626 | swati_cm@hotmail.com LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/swatimehendale/

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Techno-functional Business Analyst / Project Manager with 20+ years of BFSI experience delivering global transformation initiatives across Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Fund Administration, Asset Management and Alternative Investments. Proven expertise in leading end-to-end SDLC delivery from business case, requirements gathering, BRDs, FRDs, functional specifications, workflow modelling, solution design, SIT, UAT, implementation and production support. Strong experience partnering with Front Office, Operations, Finance, Technology and Compliance stakeholders across US, EMEA and APAC. Extensive knowledge of Trade Lifecycle, FX, OTC Derivatives, Regulatory Reporting, Digital Transformation, Workflow Automation, Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

CORE COMPETENCIES • Business Analysis: BRD, FRD, Functional Specifications, Process Mapping, Workflow Modelling, Data



•



Mapping, Gap Analysis, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria Project Management: End-to-End SDLC, Project Governance, Risk & Dependency Management, RAID Logs, Change Management, Project Closure, Lessons Learned Testing: Test Strategy, SIT, UAT, Test Cases, Defect Management, Sign-offs, Production Validation Capital Markets: Investment Banking, Trade Lifecycle, OTC Derivatives, FX, Regulatory Reporting, Fund Administration Tools: SQL, Power BI, JIRA, Confluence, Visio, Miro, SharePoint, Postman, Git, Microsoft Office

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Associate Director (Product Owner) | Aithon Solutions | Apr 2025 – Nov 2025 •

Led requirements workshops for AI-powered NAV Oversight platform for Alternative Investment Funds. Prepared BRDs, FRDs, user stories, workflow diagrams and acceptance criteria. Partnered with Technology to design automation solutions and supported UAT and implementation.

•

Vice President (Techno Functional BA) | BNY Mellon | Jul 2023 – Apr 2025 • Led end-to-end delivery of SEC NMFP, NCEN and NPORT regulatory reporting projects. • Managed requirements, solution design, SIT/UAT coordination, issue tracking and production



implementation. Collaborated with Operations, Finance, Technology and global stakeholders to deliver automation initiatives reducing manual effort by 30%.

Senior Consultant (Product Owner) | WNS Global Services | May 2021 – Jun 2023 • Delivered workflow automation products for AP and AR teams. • Managed backlog, requirements, Agile ceremonies and stakeholder communication. •

Implemented reporting dashboards and process optimisation initiatives reducing manual effort by 60%.

AVP – Investment Banking Technology | J.P. Morgan Chase | Mar 2017 – May 2021 • Led medium-to-large migration programmes across LATAM, EMEA and APAC. • Produced BRDs, FRDs, process flows, functional specifications and data mappings. • Managed trade lifecycle, settlement and MTM accounting initiatives for FX products. •

Coordinated SIT, UAT, defect management and business sign-offs with Front Office, Operations, Finance and Technology teams.

AVP – Alternative Investments Technology | J.P. Morgan Chase | Jun 2011 – Feb 2017 • Delivered regulatory reporting and digital transformation initiatives including MMIF and AIFMD





reporting. Implemented workflow re-engineering, NAV automation, PCO enhancements and HedgeTek automation. Led global stakeholder discussions, requirements gathering and implementation across hedge fund platforms.

Associate Manager (Techno Functional BA) | SS&C GlobeOp | Apr 2009 – Jun 2011 • Captured reporting requirements, created BRDs/FRDs and process maps. • Performed data mapping, gap analysis, SQL specifications, SIT/UAT support and implementation.

Associate Manager (Fund Accountant) | SS&C GlobeOp | Jul 2005 – Apr 2009 • Managed NAV, P&L, reconciliations, pricing and financial reporting for hedge funds under IFRS and US

GAAP.

Assistant Manager | SBI Mutual Fund | Oct 2003 – Jun 2005 •

Prepared financial statements, MIS, regulatory reporting and coordinated statutory audits.

EDUCATION • Cost & Management Accountant (CMA), ICWAI • B.Com, Mumbai University

CERTIFICATIONS • Generative AI for Business Analysts (Coursera) • Generative AI for Product Managers (Coursera) • Data Analysis & Visualization with Power BI (Coursera)
